title: Creating a Link returns a Manage Token (JSON API)
what: Tracer bullet for the create path. Add Flyway V4__add_manage_token_hash.sql (nullable manage_token_hash on links; V3 is spec 0004's). Add ManageTokenGenerator interface plus RandomManageTokenGenerator (32 SecureRandom bytes, unpadded base64url, 43 chars), ManageTokens (SHA-256 lower-case hex, constant-time compare via MessageDigest.isEqual, dummy-hash path) per ADR 0023. LinkService.create generates the token only after the Rule Set passes and saves its hash; LinkStore.save(shortCode, longUrl, manageTokenHash) replaces the old signature; Link carries manageToken in memory with toString that never prints it. POST /links adds manage_token and Cache-Control: no-store; 422/503 unchanged and carry no token. Test harness gets a scripted ManageTokenGenerator in the shared context and a helper that creates a Link and returns its token. Add LinkStore.findForStats(shortCode).
acceptance: POST /links 201 contains manage_token equal to the scripted value, every existing field/status/error unchanged, and Cache-Control: no-store (stories 1, 2, 7)
Two Links get different tokens (story 5)
422 and 503 responses carry no token and existing Release 1 create tests pass unchanged
Database stores only the 64-char lower-case hex SHA-256 of the token, never the token (story 6); ManageTokens unit test checks a known digest, match, non-match and dummy-hash path
RandomManageTokenGenerator unit test: 43 base64url characters, no repeats over many draws
Link.toString does not contain the token
V4 applies to an empty database and to an R10 database with Links and Clicks; old Links keep Redirecting (story 26)
Redirect tests from Release 1 and spec 0003 pass unchanged (story 25)
Plan 0001 matrix gets the P9 phase, scripted-generator principle and rows for these stories; ./mvnw verify passes

title: Stats JSON endpoint: token check, identity and headline counts
what: First read path over Clicks. Add the stats package: LinkStatsService.statsFor(shortCode, presentedToken) returning Optional<LinkStats>, LinkStatsController for GET /links/{shortCode:[A-Za-z0-9]{7}}/stats parsing Authorization case-insensitively for Bearer. Check token first (using findForStats and ManageTokens, dummy hash when Link unknown or has no hash), touch the Click Store only after a match. Add ClickStore.summarise(shortCode, windowStart) in JdbcClickStore with GROUP BY queries inside one read transaction, initially returning counts by Agent Category and latest non-bot clicked_at. Response: short_code, short_url, long_url, created_at, generated_at (injected Clock), clicks (browser+other, all time), bot_clicks, last_click_at (non-bot, null if none), by_agent_category with all three keys. Every failure gives the identical 404 application/problem+json with Cache-Control: no-store. Other fields in the contract may be absent until T3/T4.
acceptance: Right token returns 200 with identity fields, generated_at, clicks, bot_clicks, last_click_at and by_agent_category, with bots excluded from clicks and last_click_at (stories 8, 10, 15, 16, 18)
Clicks produced by real Redirects with chosen User-Agent, then Click Recorder flush(), then read over HTTP
Link with no Clicks gives zeros and null last_click_at, not an error (story 17); two Links' Stats stay separate
Unknown Short Code, Link inserted without a hash, no header, non-Bearer scheme, empty token, wrong token and another Link's token all return a 404 identical byte for byte (stories 19, 20, 26)
Responses, 200 and 404, carry Cache-Control: no-store (story 24)
LinkStatsService unit tests with stand-ins cover the 404 cases and that the Click Store is not touched without a match
Click Store summarise integration tests via saveAll with hand-built Clicks, including an empty result for an unknown Short Code
No raw User-Agent appears in the body; matrix and spec 0005 coverage rows updated; ./mvnw verify passes

title: Web create result shows the Manage Token once
what: The POST / result panel (PageController.shorten, fragments/shortener.html, app.css) shows the Manage Token in a read-only field with a copy button (reusing copy.js), the note 'Keep this safe: it's the only way to see this Link's stats, and it won't be shown again.', and a 'See its stats' link to /stats?short_code=<code> (never the token). Cache-Control: no-store on POST /. Works with HTMX and without JavaScript.
acceptance: Create result shows the token, the note and the See its stats link with the Short Code only (stories 3, 4)
POST / response has Cache-Control: no-store (story 7)
HTMX and plain requests both render the token; existing WebPageIT and WebPageHtmxIT pass
No inline script or style is added
Matrix and spec 0005 coverage rows updated; ./mvnw verify passes

title: Stats breakdowns: Device Class and top Referrer Hosts
what: Extend ClickStore.summarise and LinkStats with, over non-bot Clicks only: by_device_class (desktop and mobile keys always present), top_referrer_hosts (max 10, count descending then host ascending) and no_referrer_host. Computed with GROUP BY in the same read transaction as T2.
acceptance: by_device_class has both keys and sums to clicks; bot Clicks excluded (story 13)
top_referrer_hosts is cut at 10 with ordering by clicks desc then host asc, and no_referrer_host counts non-bot Clicks without a Referrer Host (story 14)
Click Store seam test checks counts, top-10 cut and tie-break with hand-built Clicks
HTTP test with real Redirects and chosen Referer headers; body contains no raw Referer or full referrer URL (story 23)
Matrix and spec 0005 coverage rows updated; ./mvnw verify passes

title: Stats clicks per day over a 30-day UTC window
what: Extend summarise and LinkStatsService with clicks_per_day: exactly 30 entries, today in UTC and the 29 days before, oldest first, zero-filled, non-bot Clicks only, window built from the injected Clock. clicks stays all time.
acceptance: clicks_per_day has 30 entries ending today (UTC) with zero-filled days (story 11)
A Click 29 days ago is in the series; one 30 days ago is out of the series but still counted in clicks
UTC day boundary cases in LinkStatsService unit tests with a fixed clock
Click Store seam test checks the window start
Matrix and spec 0005 coverage rows updated; ./mvnw verify passes

title: Web Link stats page at /stats
what: Add StatsPageController and templates (index and fragments/stats). GET /stats[?short_code=] renders the form pre-filling only the Short Code; POST /stats (form-encoded short_code, manage_token) renders the Stats via LinkStatsService, or 404 with 'No stats found for that Short Code and manage token.' The Short Code field accepts a bare code or a Short URL starting with the Base URL (code taken from the end). HTMX requests get only the fragment; htmx responseHandling swaps 404 for the form. Clicks per day as an accessible table with CSS-only bars; token field type=password autocomplete=off; a note that counts may lag a little; Cache-Control: no-store on all responses.
acceptance: POST /stats with a good token renders the Stats; any failure gives 404 and the message (stories 9, 19, 20)
A Short URL in the Short Code field works
HTMX requests get the fragment and plain requests the full page, working without JavaScript (ADR 0006)
GET /stats?manage_token=... never uses the token (story 21)
Page notes possible lag (story 18); no inline script or style
Responses carry Cache-Control: no-store
Matrix and spec 0005 coverage rows updated; ./mvnw verify passes

title: Privacy and log-safety tests for the Manage Token
what: Add integration tests with OutputCaptureExtension covering create, Stats success and 404 over both the JSON API and the web page, proving the token, Authorization header, manage_token form field and hash never appear in logs, URLs or error messages. Assert Stats bodies contain no IP, raw User-Agent or full Referer.
acceptance: No captured log output contains the token or its hash across create, Stats 200 and 404 (story 21)
Stats body contains none of the raw Referer or User-Agent values sent (story 23)
Error messages never include the token
Matrix and spec 0005 coverage rows updated; ./mvnw verify passes

title: Browser checks and Lighthouse for create-then-stats
what: In e2e/ (Playwright): create a Link on the page, copy the token, follow 'See its stats', enter the token, see the Stats. Assert the token is never in the page URL at any point. Add Lighthouse for /stats (median of 3, score at least 90).
acceptance: Playwright flow create, copy token, open stats, submit token, see Stats passes
Token never appears in any page URL
Lighthouse on /stats scores 90 or more (median of 3), and the existing page scores stay green
The 'Browser checks (Playwright + Lighthouse)' CI job name is unchanged

title: Document Stats: glossary, architecture, onboarding, plan and index
what: Update docs for spec 0005: CONTEXT.md (Manage Token, Stats, Headline Click count), docs/architecture.md (create flow with token, Stats flow), docs/onboarding.md (try Stats locally), plan 0001 final P9 matrix and spec 0005 coverage table, README, docs/specs/README.md index and status, R2 row in docs/roadmap.md. Fix ADR 0023's reference to V3__add_manage_token_hash.sql to V4 (V3 is expiring Links) as a clarifying note. Spec status moves in-progress to implemented when the last ticket merges.
acceptance: CONTEXT.md defines Manage Token, Stats and Headline Click count with the avoid-lists
architecture.md shows the create and Stats flows in Mermaid
onboarding.md explains trying Stats locally (using PORT=8765 and a scratch DATA_DIR)
Every user story 1-29 maps to a test in the plan 0001 coverage table
README, spec index and roadmap R2 row updated; ADR 0023 migration number corrected
Links in the docs resolve
